description: This is a security module implementing password hashing and verification functions using hashlib and hmac, including salt and pepper handling.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] hash_password(password: str, salt: str | None = None)
methods.description: Hashes a password using SHA256 with salt and optional pepper, returning the salt and hash.

methods.name: bool verify_password(password: str, salt: str, hash_hex: str)
methods.description: Verifies if a password matches the stored hash given the salt and hash.

ctags.name: hash_password
ctags.pattern: /^def hash_password(password: str, salt: str | None = None) -> Tuple[str, str]:$/

ctags.name: verify_password
ctags.pattern: /^def verify_password(password: str, salt: str, hash_hex: str) -> bool:$/
